description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, particularly USD, with features such as dynamic decimal precision, optional credit suffixes, and consistent display styles across an application.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as currency text with optional credits suffix, ensuring consistent formatting, dynamic precision, and optional inclusion of credits when currency is USD.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function that formats USD amounts with credits appended; wraps formatCurrencyAmount with includeCredits set to true.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with thousands separators and up to six decimal places, used for displaying small or precise amounts.
